title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. pusilla
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. pusilla, commonly known as Dwarf lady's mantle, is a small, perennial plant species within the Asters family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf lady's mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties.
